name: benchpod
description: Drive an EmbeddedCI BenchPod hardware-in-the-loop bench: flash firmware, power the board, read its UART, emulate I2C sensors, capture logic and analog signals, and talk CAN.

connection.title: BenchPod connection
connection.description: The pod's IP address or host[:port] on your network, or embeddedci:<device-name> for a cloud pod. Leave empty to give it to the agent in chat.

la_voltage.title: Board I/O voltage
la_voltage.description: The board's I/O voltage: 3.3 or 1.8. Leave empty and the agent sets it before using the pins.

api_key.title: embeddedci.com API key
api_key.description: Needed only for cloud pods and the waveform library. Create one at https://www.embeddedci.com/api-keys.
